messages:
yara: Noticing odd clustering in the embed index after int3 quant bring-up. Lots of semantically different paraphrases are collapsing to same nearest neighbor.

diego: can you share a small repro?

yara: dropped a dump in s3://redwood-internal/quant-int3/embedding-cluster-dump/2026-03-10/ — contains ~1k prompt pairs, embeddings from fp16 and int3, and a simple script to compute pairwise cosine diffs.

yara: Quick observation: fp16 NN distances median=0.84, int3 median=0.65. For many paraphrase pairs cosine(fp16)>0.9 but cosine(int3)<0.7. Suspect quantization-induced vector collapse.

ned: that would break our dedupe and golden maintenance flows. If paraphrases map to the same canonical, we'll over-merge. :grimace: Any particular tokenizer or model variant?

yara: int3-ranger-v2 on a 2-layer quant kernel. Happens across english & multi-lingual samples but more pronounced on short prompts (<40 tokens).

diego: what’s the impact on the golden set?

yara: ran a quick pass: of 12k gold examples, ~420 pairs now fall below our dedupe threshold (cosine>0.92) in fp16 but drop under 0.8 in int3. That yields 2.5% potential false-merge risk.

ned: ok we need coordinated action: (1) freeze automated merge workflow for any dedupe decisions based on int3 embeddings, (2) run human triage on borderline merges, (3) adjust offline triage thresholds for quantized models and include model-variant tag in index.

yara: agreed. Proposed immediate mitigations: - add model_variant to embedding index entries; - store both fp16 and quantized embedding vectors (or at least cached fingerprint) so dedupe can choose correct comparator; - set a temporary stricter cosine threshold for int3 (>=0.88) pending evaluation.

diego: storing both vectors looks best long-term but might balloon the index size. How many models will we need?

yara: for now only onboarding models should keep their quant and fp16 embeddings side-by-side. That's ~10 models active at a time. Storage delta tolerable.

labeler-bot: Created triage job: int3-embed-dedupe-triage-20260310 — 500 tasks, redundancy=2. Link: https://labeling.redwood/jobs/int3-embed-dedupe-triage-20260310

ned: Triaging instructions: show pair A (original gold) vs pair B (candidate merge). Labelers choose KEEP / MERGE / AMBIG. If AMBIG attach short note. For MERGE, pick canonical id. Two pass: triage then golden adjudication for AMBIGs.

yara: added an automated prefilter: only surface pairs where fp16 similarity>=0.9 and int3 similarity<=0.82 to reduce labeler load. That focuses on likely quant-induced collapses.

diego: timeline?

ned: propose triage complete in 36h, golden adjudication 24h after. If >3% of gold get MERGE/DROP due to int3 discrepancy, we block int3 from shipping for onboarding until root cause fixed.
yara: I’ll also add an onboarding test: compare embedding concordance across quant variants on the sample bank. If concordance (fraction of top-1 same neighbor) <95% we fail.

diego: good. Also flag the eval dashboards to show separate curves for fp16 vs quant embeddings so PMs can see drift.

infra-bot: Feature flag created: embed.index.store_fp16_and_quant -> off by default. Rollout path: canary group=onboard-models -> global if stable.

labeler-bot: Job accepted by labeler-team quick-gold. ETA: 2026-03-11T22:00Z.

yara: one more ask: can infra collect token-length buckets for these pairs? My hunch is short prompts are worst. If true we can route short-prompts to fp16 comparator in eval pipeline.

infra-bot: Added metric export: embed.pipeline.metrics.token_length_bucket and quant.concordance.rate to telemetry.

ndiego: small follow-up: adjust dedupe CI to run against both vectors. PR incoming to ops repo.

yara: I pushed a small notebook summarizing cluster shifts and some example pairs in the s3 bucket. I’ll update with labeler links once triage starts.

labeler-bot: Quick update: 120/500 triage tasks completed, preliminary MERGE rate 9%, AMBIG 6%.

ned: ok keep monitoring. If MERGE rate stays >5% we'll trigger the block.

yara: thanks. We should avoid mass-removal of gold; prefer aliasing (alias_of canonical_id) so we can revert easily if false positives are found.

diego: agreed. Also add a note to model-onboard runbook: "if quant variant induces >5% embed discordance, fail onboarding and file kernel/quant ticket."

infra-bot: Ticket created: KERNEL-2026-303 — investigate int3 vector collapse and kernel quant scaling.

labeler-bot: Triage complete: 500/500 -> MERGE 28, KEEP 442, AMBIG 30. Mapping file: s3://redwood-internal/quant-int3/triage/mapping-20260310.csv

n ed: reading results — MERGE rate = 5.6% of surfaced pairs. Given our prefilter that targets likely cases, this maps to ~1.4% of the entire goldset. Below the 3% blockade threshold; proceed with cautious aliasing.

yara: Ill apply aliases and reindex. After that we should re-run onboarding evals against the updated gold and report any metric shifts.

diego: thanks everyone. Keep the PRs linked and post the final manifest version here when done.

labeler-bot: Golden adjudication scheduled for flagged AMBIGs: 30 tasks, redundancy=3. Link: https://labeling.redwood/jobs/int3-embed-golden-20260311

infra-bot: Reindex job queued: job-id REINDEX-20260311-77. Expected completion: 2026-03-12T04:00Z.

yara: closing loop: after reindex we will run the concordance test across the onboarding sample bank; if pass, we allow int3 for non-golden evals but keep fp16 comparator for golden maintenance.

diego: capture follow-ups in runbook and set an alert when future quant onboarding jobs change concordance by >2% relative to baseline.

yara: will do. thanks all. :heart:
